maximum_depth_rule: All 1,500 canonical Phase 9 Reviewed statements remain raw maximum-depth records until strategy, policy, measure, KPI, implementation, annual-progress, and evaluation layers can be mapped through reviewed table-level evidence.
hierarchy_boundary: Strategy, policy and measure hierarchy, KPI definitions, implementation plans, project evaluations, and annual progress remain separate source roles until their identifiers and responsibility layers are verified.
evaluation_boundary: Official evaluation labels and progress descriptions remain source classifications. Missing, unknown, qualitative, or non-assessed values are not converted to failure, zero, or an achievement judgment.
series_boundary: Current, baseline, target, annual actual, cumulative, reference, national, budget, settlement, and project-cost values remain separate until definitions, units, periods, populations, and organizations are reviewed.
non_goals: Do not merge records across the six official documents by similar wording alone.
Do not infer missing units, reporting years, populations, or responsible organizations.
Do not convert plan values or baselines into annual actuals.
Do not convert targets or reference values into comparable time series.
Do not interpret qualitative evaluations as numeric achievement rates.
Do not calculate policy causality or cross-prefecture ranking.
